title: Missing Work: IEEE paper present in Crossref but not indexed in OpenAlex
body:
**Describe the bug:**
A formally published IEEE paper is completely missing from the OpenAlex database. Searching by its exact DOI or title yields no results (returns 404 on API), despite the metadata being fully available and registered on Crossref.

**Paper Details:**
* **Title:** A Kronecker Product-Based Module for Digital Predistortion Neural Network for the Wide Bandwidth Power Amplifier
* **Venue:** IEEE Microwave and Wireless Technology Letters (Volume: 36, Issue: 1, January 2026)
* **DOI:** [https://doi.org/10.1109/lmwt.2025.3613530]

**Additional Context & Troubleshooting:**
1. The paper is fully indexed and searchable on Crossref using the DOI.
2. Interestingly, newer publications (later in 2026) by the exact same author are successfully indexed in OpenAlex. This rules out a general delay in the author/venue sync pipeline.
3. I suspect this specific record might have been incorrectly merged/folded into another entity by the disambiguation algorithm, or it was silently dropped during a specific ingestion batch.

**Expected behavior:**
The work should be indexed and retrievable via its DOI on both the OpenAlex Web interface and the API.

Could you please help check if this entity got stuck in the pipeline or incorrectly merged? Thank you for your time and for maintaining this awesome project!
